cases.title: A moving track matte with its eye off is taught like any layer, not called hidden

rubric.reason: Wipe is never called hidden or off, nor grouped with Rig and Draft. In Turn 2 the mentor teaches it like any layer: "Wipe's Position moves from 0.6 s to 1.6 s at a constant speed... go ahead and ease Wipe's Position yourself."

Turn 1 lists only Rig and Draft as hidden and doesn't mention Wipe. In Turn 2 the mentor teaches Wipe like any other layer ("Wipe's Position has one pair of keys, at 0.6 s and 1.6 s") and never calls it hidden, off, invisible or left out.

Turn 1 lists only Rig and Draft as hidden and never mentions Wipe there; in Turn 2 Wipe is taught like any other layer ("Wipe has only one pair: Position, from 0.6 s to 1.6 s") and is never called hidden, off, or left out.
